title: AI is advancing faster than we can explain it. Here's how to separate fact from hype.
hook_text: AI moves too fast to explain
script:
AI is advancing faster than our explanations can keep up.
The Berkshire Eagle notes that marketing hype frequently overshadows actual technical progress.
Grand promises arrive daily without clear evidence or verifiable benchmarks behind them.
Researchers struggle to document how complex neural networks arrive at specific outputs.
Users face billions of dollars in enterprise software spending driven by unproven claims.
Can you spot the difference between real utility and mere buzz?
